listing.name: Wolfenstein: Enemy Territory (ET: Legacy)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Official etlegacy.com stable 2.86.2 desktop installer/archive plus original freely released Wolfenstein: Enemy Territory data; package and original data are distinct. Limits: Maintained native continuation; official download site linked in README. GitHub Releases empty; resolve official package + original free data route. Upstream platforms: Official stable2.86.2 Windows x86/x86-64, Linux i386/x86-64/AArch64 and macOS x86-64/AArch64 installer/archive downloads.64-bit mods must match64-bit client. Original data: Use original free Wolfenstein: Enemy Territory game data under its original EULA; copy pak0.pk3 into etmain/. Third-party mods may also need pak1.pk3 and pak2.pk3. README links Splash Damage for the free release and targets compatibility with ET 2.60b; the GPL engine/mod source alone does not include game data. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
